## F — Research and VERIFY index: Be in shape to drive

Research index: Be in shape to drive; mapped physical pages 18, 19, 20, 21, 22.
Part C contains 42 knowledge facts and part C2 contains 49 continuation facts. Individual source anchors and preaccept receipts preserve traceability.
VERIFY index: sec05-COUNT — exact official question count; sec05-PASS — exact official passing score; sec05-TIME — exact official duration; sec05-CADENCE — revision frequency.
Market and competitor debts: SEC-FITNESS-MARKET and SEC-FITNESS-COMPETITORS. Source-specific cautions are in part D.
Revision stability remains unknown, so the dossier carries a blocked-probe flag pending evidence; factual compilation is not independent QA or release acceptance.
VERIFY sec05-ALCOHOL-SCHEDULE-CONTEXT: Physical page20 general first alcohol-conviction summary and DWI-specific penalty bullets use different license-loss durations; clarify applicability before learner-facing legal summaries. The underage BAC range also varies across page12 and page20 wording.
VERIFY sec05-DATED-CRASH-STATISTIC: The handbook fatal-crash percentage has no study year in the selected text; do not present it as current epidemiology without dated primary evidence.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
